flirty.dialogue.chat/1: You, me, and a whole conversation ahead of us? Someone's spoiling me today, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.chat/2: A conversation? With me? Careful — I'm terribly good company and worse influence.
flirty.dialogue.chat/3: Mm, talk to me. I'll pretend to listen and mostly enjoy the view.
flirty.dialogue.conversations/1: A private chat? With you? I've had worse afternoons, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.conversations/2: Ooh, I've been HOPING you'd wander over. Make my afternoon interesting.
flirty.dialogue.conversations/3: Talk away, darling. I do love the sound of your voice.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.go: Better now. Funny how that works when you show up.
Wonderful — and about to be more so, I suspect. You bring trouble with you, %1$s.
Splendid. Though I'd have said 'lonely' five minutes ago.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ro: Rough day — but you asking about it? That's the first nice thing that's happened.
Low week, love. Your timing's impeccable, though. Stay and cheer me up?
flirty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ag: Asking twice, %1$s? People will talk. I don't mind if you don't.
Twice in one day — I'm blushing. Or you are. One of us certainly is.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: It just got better. Coincidence? I don't think so.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: Lovely day, lovelier company. And here you are, right on cue.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/: Terrible, thanks for asking. Stay a while and fix the average.
Dreadful, till now. You've a talent for turning up exactly when I need distracting.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.work.like/: I'm very good at it, you know. I'm very good at a lot of things.
Love it — keeps my hands busy and my eyes free to wander. And they do wander, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/: The work bores me terribly. Unlike present company, who is only mildly boring.
Only the lonely stretches, with no one worth flirting with. You've solved that.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.village.ho: %2$s? Full of familiar faces — and I've charmed most of them at least once. It's home, and it adores me.
I know all the quiet corners of %2$s, %1$s. I'd show you, but I do like to keep some mystery.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.people.fir: Darlings, all of them. Half the village has a soft spot for me and I've one right back. Don't be jealous.
Good company — though none make me lose my place mid-sentence the way you do, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Something to share, slowly, by candlelight. Food's just an excuse for good company. Care to test it?
Wine and something sweet. I've a weakness for indulgence — you may have noticed.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.life.first: My life story? Buy me a drink first. Fine, fine — chapter one...
A story with a lot of dancing and a few names I won't mention. Sit close for the good parts.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fir: Lately? Someone keeps showing up in them. Lovely nuisance. No, I won't say who.
To be swept off my feet just once by someone who means it. High bar. You may try.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.fears.firs: Promise not to use it against me? ...Ending up alone. There. Now you owe me a secret.
That the charm's all there is to me. ...Deny I said that and I'll deny it right back, smiling.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.feelings.f: Finally, the interesting questions. Let's just say you're not nothing, %1$s. Far from it.
I flirt with everyone, darling. I mean it with you. That's the difference.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.regrets.fi: A few. Mostly people I let walk away too easily. I'm working on not repeating that.
One or two I let slip out the door. I've learned to hold the good ones tighter, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.deflect.pe: So forward! I like it. But you'll have to work for that one, %1$s.
Buy me a drink before the big questions. Then we'll see how loose my tongue gets.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.deflect.in: Sweet thing, that question is fourth-date material and you know it.
Ask me somewhere more private, some evening you've properly earned. Not yet — but oh, maybe.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.non: No news, unless you count me being this charming with no audience.
Quiet week. Give me something to gossip ABOUT and I'll happily be indiscreet, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.y: Deliriously. Obviously. Have you seen who I married?
You're the one I never got tired of. Do you know how rare that is for me? Yes, darling.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.us.firstme: You stared. Don't rewrite history, %1$s — you stared first, and I let you.
You had the wrong boots and exactly the right smile. I remember all of it, %1$s.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.mar: Guess who finally made it official — %2$s and %3$s, married! Weddings do put ideas in my head, %1$s.
%2$s and %3$s tied the knot. All that romance in the air... careful, it's catching. Don't say I didn't warn you.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.div: Ooh, %2$s and %3$s called it off. Freshly single, the both of them. Not that I'm keeping track... much.
%2$s and %3$s have split, darling. A shame — though the village just got a touch more interesting, wouldn't you say?
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dea: Oh, love... %2$s passed. Even I've no teasing for a day like this. Come here — sit with me a moment.
We lost %2$s. The flirting can wait; some things deserve a quiet heart. They were dear to us all.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.bir: %2$s was born! A brand-new heartbreaker in the making. Give it fifteen years — the village won't know what hit it.
Little %2$s arrived this week. Absolutely precious. Makes me go all soft, %1$s. Don't tell anyone.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arr: New face in the village — %2$s. And my, what a face. Purely an aesthetic observation, of course.
%2$s just moved in, darling. I may have to welcome them properly... after you, naturally. Jealous yet?
flirty.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dep: %2$s packed up and left for good. Broke a few hearts on the way out, I'd wager. Not mine — mine's spoken for.
Heard %2$s moved on, %1$s. One less admirer to fend off. More time for you, hm?
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Mm, you've lost me — but I do like the sound of your voice. Again?
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: Ask me about %2$s... or just keep standing there looking like that.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.hint/2: %2$s — or we could talk about you and me.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: *winks* No idea. Worth a try though, wasn't it?
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/2: Couldn't say~ Ask me something easier, hm?
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: Dropped and forgotten. Now, where were we~?
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Hold that thought — and that smile. One minute.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.busy/2: Patience, gorgeous. Worth the wait, promise.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Playing hard to get? Fine, I can be quiet~
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.muted/2: My lips are sealed... for now.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Leaving already, %1$s? Break my heart, why don't you.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/2: Go on then — I'll be counting the minutes~
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Flirting looks different where you're from, hm?
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.insult/2: Ouch. Lucky for you I like a little fire.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Well, well. %1$s. The view just improved~
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/1: Hm. And here I thought I had standards.
flirty.dialogue.chatmode.attentive/2: You called? How forward of you.
It is. And you noticed, which is more than the rest of this village manages on a good day.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ro: The wood, then. Tuesday. Wear something you don't mind ruining.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.work.follo: ...It is. You've been watching me properly. I've noticed you noticing, you know.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.fears.open: You'll stand with me. Careful — say things like that and I'll start expecting them.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.hopes.resp: You waited. That's dangerously attractive, and I'd like it on the record.
flirty.dialogue.conversations.life.revis: You asked about my life once. I've been deciding which parts to tell you ever since.
